title: When AGI is 1000x smarter than any human genius - we build a city.
intro: Black. The internet's headlines flicker past, one darker than the next: AGI takes the jobs, AGI ends work, AGI ends us. A voice: soon an AGI will be a thousand times smarter than any human genius, and everyone tells you how that ends. Cut to light: a city grown into a forest, food on every path, people living in nature. Solarpunk: until now a dream, a picture on a screen. With a mind that strong it stops being a dream and becomes reality. Here is how we start: first in a game, then for real. Cut: one white tent on an empty meadow. Day 1 of 5,423.
